title: Finite-strip row map is epic onto the filtration step
statement: Let C be an abelian category and K an integer commuting double cochain complex with total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let r be natural and assume K.X i is zero for i<0 or r<=i. Let A be an integer cochain complex, b:A→Tot(K), and f_p:single(A.X p,0)→K.flip.X p for every integer p. Let F be a decreasing filtration of Cone(b) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], whose degree-n step p is the join of the source image when p<=n+1 and the target diagonal images indexed by 0<=i<r and p<=n-i. The canonical map [def-sc-finite-strip-cone-graded-map], obtained by factoring the row inclusion through the current filtration step and projecting to its quotient by the next step, is an epimorphism onto the graded piece for all integer p,n.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteStripGradedMap_factorThru_epi
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (f : ∀ p : ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X p) ⟶ K.flip.X p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone b))
    (hsteps : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
      (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl b).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
      (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (r : ℤ)).sup (fun i ↦
        if p ≤ n - i then imageSubobject
          (K.ιTotalOrZero (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i (n - i) n ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr b).f n) else ⊥))
    (p n : ℤ) : Epi (finiteStripGradedMap K r hsupport A b f F hsteps p n)

statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED (original): when p<n+1 the row has zero projection to the source A.X(n+1), while hsteps contains that source image. For K=0, r=0, A concentrated in degree 1, p=n=0, the row is zero and the current step is nonzero. The intended result is epimorphy onto the quotient by the next step. No hypotheses or definitions change.

old_proof.text: Identify the image of the row inclusion with the supremum prescribed by hsteps. The induced map from the row cone into the step subobject is therefore epic by the image-subobject characterization of epimorphisms.
